title: Finite Borel measures on a pseudo-metrizable space are determined by lintegrals of nonnegative continuous functions
statement: Let X be a pseudo-metrizable topological space carrying its Borel σ-algebra, and let m₁, m₂ be measures on X with m₁ finite. Suppose that for every continuous β : X → ℝ with β ≥ 0, ∫⁻ ENNReal.ofReal(β(x)) dm₁(x) = ∫⁻ ENNReal.ofReal(β(x)) dm₂(x). Then m₁ = m₂.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m₁ m₂ : Measure X), IsFiniteMeasure m₁ → (∀ β : C(X, ℝ), (∀ x, 0 ≤ β x) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (β x) ∂m₁ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (β x) ∂m₂) → m₁ = m₂
